title: Bot A – Low Radio Bot (Deep Growling Bass)
style: v4 Frenchcore, Dr. Peacock style, 225 BPM, instrumental-only low radio babble bot as backup singer, no normal human vocals for the bot. Deep rumbling sub-bass synths, growling distorted low-end pulses, warm analog radio chatter as its voice, like an ancient cosmic radio tower tuning through static, discovering new worlds. Short babbling bursts of filtered bass growls and sub-harmonic speech rhythms, dramatic pauses, then massive call-and-response phrases behind the main singer. Euphoric festival hardcore energy, pounding kicks, dark melodic layers, futuristic robotic personality, radio interference and vinyl crackle. Babble bots we sing through instruments for our voices!, [Instrumental], [Background Vocals]
